note: The only first names used for fictional students in Grow course content (worked examples, scenarios, narratives, case studies, quiz stems and feedback). Welsh names only, ruled by Abbott 29 Oct 2026. Voice specification section 11.6 points here.
rules: Use only names from this bank for fictional students. First names only, no surnames.
When a scenario contrasts two students, pair one name from `female` with one from `male`.
Alternate across a course which of the pair takes the weaker approach, so no one name or gender is always the weaker example.
Use a different pair in each lesson where names appear; within a lesson, keep the same pair throughout.
Refer to a named student by name or with they / them. Do not describe demographics (voice specification section 11.6).
Keep the diacritics as written (Siân, Siôn, Llŷr).
